description:
Shows **when** a Home Assistant sensor will be done as a Smartspacer target, e.g. "Washing machine · done at 14:40".

**Target: Home Assistant Timer**
- Reads the finish time of an appliance (washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, …) through the Home Assistant REST API (base URL, long-lived access token, entity ID)
- Works with timestamp sensors (`device_class: timestamp`) and with sensors that report the remaining time as a number (seconds, minutes, hours, days)
- Shows the point in time instead of a countdown, so the display never goes stale
- Says "Done" for a configurable time after the cycle ends (default 30 minutes), then disappears on its own; hidden completely while the appliance is off
- Picks a matching icon from the sensor's `icon`, its name or its `device_class`
- Tapping the target opens the entity's history in the Home Assistant app (browser fallback if the app is not installed)
- Can be added multiple times, each with its own instance and entity

**Good to know**
- Checks for a new finish time about every 15 minutes, also while the phone is idle (Doze) and after a reboot
- The access token is stored encrypted on the device; the plugin only talks to your own Home Assistant instance
- Local `http://` addresses are supported
- English and German

**Requires Android 17 or newer.**

Setup guide and source code: [github.com/WEITERFUNKEN-Thomas/HATimerSmartspacerTarget](https://github.com/WEITERFUNKEN-Thomas/HATimerSmartspacerTarget/blob/main/README.en.md)
